name: Appwrite
description: Appwrite is an open-source backend platform for authentication, databases, storage, functions, messaging, realtime APIs, and app hosting. This template launches the official Appwrite Docker installer wizard, which creates the full self-hosted Appwrite Docker Compose stack.

paths.name: Install Directory
paths.description: Persistent Appwrite installer directory. The wizard writes the generated docker-compose.yml, .env, and related installation files here.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Host Docker socket required by the official Appwrite installer so it can create and manage the generated Appwrite stack.

ports.name: Install Wizard Port
ports.description: Appwrite web installer wizard port. This port is needed only while installing or reconfiguring Appwrite. Container port: 20080.
